Qlaas DMI is a structured endpoint beside your existing systems. It gives authorised agents a direct route to information, actions and the evidence of what happened.

How an action is exposed
  01: Expose an action
  02: Assign explicit authority
  03: Return a checkable result

You define the actions an agent can request, the records it can access and when its permission expires. The page links the live MCP endpoint, the communications OpenAPI description and the discovery document.
